name: Meidensha Corporation
summary: Meidensha Corporation engages in the power infrastructure; public, industrial, and commercial sector; mobility and electrical components; field service engineering; and real estate businesses in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company provides vacuum circuit breakers and interrupters; high-voltage switchgears; transformers; mobile substations; zinc oxide blocks; surge arresters; turbine and engine generators; biomass power generation systems; and photovoltaic and hydroelectric power systems.
